scope: Timetable service eligibility on web and native iOS, with an isolated research prototype and fetch probe.

integrationPoints.finding: Already requests TrainInfo and StopTimes. Raw nested SuspendedFlag can be retained without changing the select.
SuspendedFlag, StopSequence and source metadata are not typed.
Only delayMap determines status. cancelled is in the response union but never assigned.
Stores only selected origin/destination stops. Classify partial service before slicing or retain full journey stop context.
Cached daily and derived OD schedules need explicit service-age policy and invalidation after refreshed flags.
Filter boardable journeys before sorting, choosing the visible window and recommending a train.
Show only boardable journeys; guard selection, sharing and persisted widget projection.
Already excludes cancelled. Extend protection to unresolved partial and stale service states; reconcile existing snapshots.

proposedRollout: Validate authenticated production payloads and update frequency, including an actual partial suspension, before choosing a refresh budget.
Model service availability separately from live delay status. Keep date+train+origin+destination and source/fetch times.
Use shared budgeted refresh, conditional requests where supported, and atomic derived-route invalidation. Old content must not receive a new freshness timestamp unless validated.

Use Alert structured scopes as candidate advisories. Confirm section overlap with ordered station/line topology before claiming this journey is affected. Alert.Direction is south/north while timetable Direction is clockwise/counterclockwise.
Do not infer cancellation from no live-board record, missing timetable entry, an Alert Status=2, or a News keyword. Keep uncertain evidence as a human-readable notice.
Normalize cancellation before parsing nullable stop times so withdrawn departures are retained as cancelled notices.
Ship web/Android and iOS selection, sharing and widget eligibility together after accepting the visual and behavior decisions.

prototypePolicy.partial: Block automatic recommendation; open endpoints alone cannot confirm a through journey.
prototypePolicy.alert: Candidate route advisory; block auto recommendation in this prototype pending human verification. Do not relabel as cancelled.
prototypePolicy.stale: Hide the train until a fresh service snapshot confirms eligibility.
prototypePolicy.share: Preview only; no real outbound sharing.

implemented: TDX train/stop suspension flags projected independently from live delays
Suspended stop names retained through OD slicing; derived routes rebuilt after daily source changes with source fetch age preserved
Web and native iOS lists show only boardable journeys, with next-available selection and the existing empty state
Arrival sharing and widget guards for cancelled, unresolved partial and unknown service
Debug-only matched showcase scenarios for both clients
remainingProposals: Route Alert/News ingestion and advisory UI in the actual clients
An intraday timetable refresh budget and source freshness limit validated against authenticated payloads
Automatic stale-suspension expiry; 120 seconds remains a prototype-only policy
